reviews.review_text: Being a working professional with 4+ years of experience, enrolling under the NMIMS online EMBA was quite challenging for me, but honestly, it is a completely worth it course for skill development and upliftment.

One of my previous organization's managers told me about the NMIMS online executive MBA for career advancement. I still thank him to date, as now we both are working in the same company, and I got a senior management job role with an 80% hike!
I am totally satisfied with the academic support and education quality offered under the NMIMS online EMBA and highly recommend it to others!!

If you are interested in upskilling without a professional career break, my personal recommendation is the NMIMS online EMBA. It has a perfect balance of every required aspect a working executive asks for. However, consider your preferences too before enrolling, period.

faqs.question: What is the NMIMS Online Executive MBA in Leadership & Strategy all about?
faqs.answer: The NMIMS Online Executive MBA in Leadership & Strategy equips the essential leadership skills and abilities among enrolled candidates to assist them in becoming responsive global leaders.

faqs.question: How are leadership and strategy different from a general MBA specialization?
faqs.answer: Leadership and strategy develop the core competencies among professionals to lead and tackle the business organization and its human capital, whereas a general MBA specialization equips students with core management and business skills.

faqs.question: Is this program accredited and recognized by UGC or AICTE?
faqs.answer: This program is recognized by the UGC (University Grants Commission).

faqs.question: What are the key features of the Leadership & Strategy specialization?
faqs.answer: Strategic Knowledge Management, Strategic Business Process Management, Art of Leadership, and HR Analytics are some of the key features of the Leadership & Strategy specialization.

faqs.question: Does NMIMS provide placement or executive coaching support?
faqs.answer: Yes, NMIMS provides placement or executive coaching support with mentorship assistance to keep students updated with global job openings.

faqs.question: What industries commonly recruit for this specialization?
faqs.answer: Management Consulting, Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma, and EdTech are some major industries that commonly recruit for this specialization.

data.placement_content:
The NMIMS online executive MBA is a specially designed online postgraduate degree for working professionals who are currently working and looking for better working opportunities without a career gap. Simultaneously, the students enrolled in this program have an ideal target to enhance their skills and abilities to increase their earning potential and demand fewer employment assistance services.

However, the NMIMS CDOE has provided one-on-one mentorship without any charges under its "Career Development Services" on the alumni portal. It allows enrolled students to build a network and connections with industry professionals and get updated information on job openings.

data.eligibility_content:
Online Executive MBA Eligibility Criteria

Working professionals willing to upgrade their career without a professional gap can pursue the NMIMS online executive MBA course by fulfilling the below-mentioned eligibility criteria:

  • The applicants must have completed a bachelor's degree in any stream from a recognized university/institution.
  • A minimum of 55% marks at graduation is necessary for general category students. However, a 5% relaxation is awarded to students from SC/ST/OBC/PwD.
  • A valid 3+ years of work experience is essential to pursue this degree program.
  • Students who qualify for the above-mentioned eligibility criterion are required to appear for a personal interview, where they must show their zest, aptitude, and leadership potential.
data.admission_steps:
The complete admission process for the NMIMS online executive MBA involves below listed steps:

Step 1. Registration: Visit the official website of NMIMS CDOE and register.

Step 2. Application Form: Fill out the application form and pay the required application fee along with it.

Step 3. Document Submission: Attach the supporting documents along with the application form, including photo identity, academic transcript, passport size photograph, etc.

Step 4. Personal Interview: Appear for a virtual interview and showcase your motivation for the working executive course with leadership qualities.

Step 5. Fee Submission: Pay the prescribed course fee and finalize your admission.

Step 6. Confirmation: Once the university verifies your details, fee payment, and submitted documents, a "student number" is allotted, and your admission process is completed.

The NMIMS CDOE offers an online executive MBA in leadership and strategy for working professionals aspiring for top-tier executive job roles across diverse industries. The course is delivered through a 100% virtual learning mode that completely blends with the busy schedules of working professionals.

The NMIMS online EMBA in leadership and strategy course guides professionals in acquiring relevant skills, knowledge, and information to become responsive and successful leaders. The course develops a strong foundation in leadership with the essential course on strategy, which offers a global perspective on today's global business situations.

Students have the opportunity to receive guidance from leading business leaders and thinkers, who assist them in developing a comprehensive understanding of eminent theories and business models. The NMIMS online executive MBA in leadership and strategy entitles candidates to become CEOs, Senior Strategy Leaders, Team Leaders, or other prominent job roles in global business organizations.

data.exam_content:
The NMIMS online courses examination process is similar for both UG and PG programs. The exams are conducted through an online proctored platform that allows students to appear for the examinations from any corner of the globe; they only need a good internet connection, a laptop, and a working webcam.

The NMIMS online examinations follow an evaluation method of IA + TEE, which stands for Internal Assessment + Term End Examinations.

highlights.highlight_description: The course is designed to transform experienced working professionals into future-proof leaders.

The curriculum consists of 8 terms, among which the initial 15 months are dedicated to intensive academic and 9 months of experiential learning.
